name: Summer Design Experience
org: K-State College of Architecture, Planning and Design
what_you_do: Try architecture, industrial design and interior architecture. You visit studio labs and meet K-State design professors. You finish a final project. You stay in a campus dorm.
who_can_apply: High school students. The page does not list a grade or age rule.
pay_detail: $800 in 2026. A limited number of scholarships are offered for students with financial need. Kansas and Kansas City area students get priority.
deadline_text: 2026 registration closed on Friday, May 29, 2026. The program page does not list 2027 dates.
how_to_apply: Use the Register Now link on the program page. For a scholarship, use the Apply for Scholarship link on the same page.
notes: The page calls it a three-day program but lists June 24 to 27. Check the dates when 2027 registration opens.
